name: Shadowborn
source:
A young vampire finds her mind bound to an ancient being. To survive, she must defy centuries-old traditions, and two hundred years later, face the consequences of her choices. 
[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Shadowborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻的女吸血鬼发现自己的意识与一尊远古存在紧紧相连。为了活下去，她必须公然违抗延续数百年之久的古老传统；而在两百年后，她也终将直面当年抉择所带来的沉重后果。
[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Shadowborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
